maximum_depth_rule: All 392 Phase 9 Reviewed statements from the new 2026-2029 Ibaraki comprehensive plan remain raw maximum-depth records until current values and targets can be mapped through a reviewed table structure.
new_plan_boundary: The current plan begins in fiscal 2026 and spans six reviewed official documents. Prior-plan results are not inherited as current-plan annual actuals, and mixed source lines are not split by inference.
non_goals: Do not infer annual actual and target fields from mixed raw statements.
Do not inherit prior-plan results into the new comprehensive plan.
Do not replace missing units or merge separate official documents.
Do not calculate achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
